name: SeekinWeb AI Visibility
author: draxork

sections.description:
Being readable by AI is not the same as being recommended by AI. This plugin measures both, from your dashboard.

1. The AI Mention Test (this is what makes this plugin different). We ask an AI assistant the questions a customer would ask when looking for what you offer, generated from your own site and without naming you, then show whether the assistant names your business, in how many of the queries, and which businesses appear in your place. That is the number that tells you if AI search is sending you customers or sending them to a competitor. No other WordPress plugin reports this.

2. Your AI Visibility Score (0-100), from SeekinWeb’s public scanner, with the fix for each of the 8 signals AI crawlers and agents actually read:

  • JS-free readability (the heaviest signal: most AI crawlers never run your JavaScript)
  • AI crawler access in robots.txt
  • Structured data (JSON-LD)
  • Semantic structure
  • Metadata
  • Performance
  • llms.txt
  • Sitemap

3. Three fixes applied in one click, with no files to edit:

  • robots.txt: explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others. A security plugin or a theme blocks them more often than you would think.
  • JSON-LD: Organization + WebSite on your home page, from your real site data.
  • llms.txt: serves /llms.txt generated from your pages and posts, or the text you write.

Why another AI plugin?

Most plugins in this space generate files (llms.txt, schema) and hope for the best. This one starts from the outcome: it asks the AI what your customers ask and reports whether you were named. Then it tells you what to fix, and fixes the cheap parts for you. The file generation is the last step here, not the product.

Honest by design

  • Nobody can guarantee that an AI will recommend you, and we never claim otherwise. The Mention Test is one assistant’s answer on a given date; it changes over time and between assistants.
  • llms.txt is an emerging convention with unproven impact. Google has stated it does not use it. We serve it because it costs nothing, and we weight it accordingly, not as a ranking factor.
  • The score is computed from documented, weighted signals. The method is public at seekinweb.com.

Español

Le hacemos a un asistente de IA las preguntas que haría tu cliente, sin nombrarte, y te mostramos si te nombra y quién aparece en tu lugar. Además obtienes tu Puntuación de Visibilidad IA (0-100) con las 8 señales que leen los crawlers de IA y su arreglo, y aplicas tres arreglos en un clic: crawlers de IA en robots.txt, JSON-LD de tu organización y /llms.txt. Todo el panel sigue el idioma de tu sitio: las cadenas del plugin y también los nombres, detalles y arreglos que devuelve el servicio.

External services

This plugin connects to the SeekinWeb API, a service run by the plugin author (https://seekinweb.com):

  • https://seekinweb.com/api/scan — called only when you click “Scan” in the admin page. It sends your site’s public home URL and receives the score, the 8 signals and the suggested llms.txt.
  • https://seekinweb.com/api/mention-test — called when the admin page is opened and the Mention Test result is not cached locally. It sends your site’s public host name and receives the result (questions, whether you were named, and the businesses named).

No personal data is sent: only the public URL of your own site. Nothing is sent unless you install and use the plugin. Service terms and privacy: https://seekinweb.com · Both endpoints are free and require no account.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins → Add New → Upload.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Visibilidad IA / AI Visibility in the admin menu and click Scan.
  4. Tick the fixes you want and save.
sections.faq:
Does it slow down my site?

No. It adds one JSON-LD block on the home page and a few lines to robots.txt. The scan runs only when you click the button.

I already use Yoast / Rank Math

Keep them. Turn off the JSON-LD option here if your SEO plugin already outputs Organization data, to avoid duplicates.

My robots.txt is a real file

Then WordPress does not generate it and the robots.txt option has no effect. Add the allow rules to your file by hand (the scan report shows the snippet).
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • The AI Mention Test now runs and is shown inside the dashboard: which questions were asked, whether you were named, and who appears in your place.
  • The whole panel now answers in your site language: signal names, details and fixes come back in English or Spanish.
  • JSON-LD output hardened (HEX_TAG escaping) and request path sanitized.
  • Readme rewritten in English.

1.0.0

  • First release: scan, 8 signals with fixes, one-click robots.txt / JSON-LD / llms.txt.
